liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **So Many Roads** (1 review): Drums dominate the mix after the band kicks in on this track [10]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Listener found the transition to Fire On The Mountain particularly touching [9]
- **Days Between** (1 review): Lesh describes the song as achingly nostalgic, climbing laboriously out of shadows [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-02-22.149126.mtx.tobin.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1993-02-22.149125.PandP-aud.tobin.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 171 min [3]. Said about its sound: Audience speed was slightly fast, running about point four seconds per minute [3]
- **gd93-02-22.dsbd.vernon.19238.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 18 songs; 172 min; rated 2.43/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Vocals are muffled and instruments overwhelm the overall sound quality; Mix is unstable, with Bob's guitar prominent but Garcia's vocals very low; Thin vocals, excessive Jerry and Phil, and little to no Bob in the mix [9][10][11]
- **gd1993-02-22.149127.dts.tobin.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 171 min [6]
- **gd1993-02-22.116143.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 154 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [8]. Said about its sound: Fraught with sound problems from the taper or live sound system [14]

## Around the show

- Listener stopped listening shortly into Scarlet Begonias due to low energy [11]
- Bob waved to soundboard engineers to fix the audio during this song [12]
- Attended alone at age twenty-one and cried during the first version [12]
- Large open space right up front in Phil Zone allowed for dancing [13]
- Major patch occurred during the Drums segment of the performance [3]
- Considered the best night of the three-night run at the Coliseum [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-02-22.149126.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [1]
- **gd1993-02-22.149125.PandP-aud.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Patched and pitch corrected audience (44/16) by Kevin Tobin; source: Patched and pitch corrected audience (44/16) [3]
- **gd93-02-22.dsbd.vernon.19238.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD: DAT > DAT > CD encoded by Matt Vernon [4]
- **gd1993-02-22.149127.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix [6]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user and converted to FLAC on February 29, 2020 [6]
- **gd1993-02-22.116143.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 2 Neumann KMF4 microphones > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [8]
